sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fuinjutsu, Earth Release, Wind Release, Stable

system.description:
You form a pair of large arms your description from dust particles. These arms materialize themselves into two different spaces of your choice within range that you can see. These arms must be in contact with solid ground.

As part of this jutsu’s casting and as a Bonus action on following turns, you can command each arm to make a melee Ninjutsu attack against different creatures you can see within 10 feet of it. On a hit, you deal 4d6 earth damage and force the target to make a Dexterity saving throw, being Grappled by the arm on a failure. A Grappled creature makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw at the end of each of their turns to end the grappled condition on a success.

Additionally, when you command an Arm as a Bonus action, you can have them move up to 30 feet into a new space that can hold them.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage the arms deal by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the number of arms you create by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the number of arms you create by +1.
